mapper.select: SELECT job_id, job_name, target_url, selector, description, active, cron_expression, created_at, updated_at FROM crawling_job ORDER BY job_id DESC
SELECT job_id, job_name, target_url, selector, description, active, cron_expression, created_at, updated_at FROM crawling_job WHERE active = true ORDER BY job_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crawling_job (job_name, target_url, selector, description, active, cron_expression, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{jobName}, #{targetUrl}, #{selector}, #{description}, #{active}, #{cronExpression}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE crawling_job SET job_name = #{jobName}, target_url = #{targetUrl}, selector = #{selector}, description = #{description}, active = #{active}, cron_expression = #{cronExpression}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE job_id = #{jobId}
